visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy with short black hair and a white t-shirt sits at a wooden table, looking expectantly toward the right. Behind him is a brightly lit room with a patterned sofa and a gold-colored desk lamp. An adult male with styled hair and a white shirt enters the frame holding a packaged Ferrero Rocher ice cream bar. (2) The adult male unwraps the gold-wrapped ice cream bar, revealing a round, chocolate-coated treat studded with hazelnut pieces. He holds it close to the camera for a macro view. The boy watches with wide eyes and a playful smile as the man pretends to take a bite before sharing it. (3) The man and the boy both sample the ice cream bar. The man speaks enthusiastically, gesturing with his hands to describe the texture while the boy takes a bite. A cross-section of the ice cream is shown, displaying the creamy chocolate interior and the thick outer nutty shell. (4) Transition to a new scene featuring a Kinder Bueno ice cream cone. The man holds the cone, which has a white chocolate swirl top. He and the boy take turns eating it. A macro shot highlights the bottom of the wafer cone, showing a solid chocolate tip inside. (5) The screen shifts to a promotional end card with multiple thumbnails of food reviews and the '料理123' logo. The man appears in a smaller inset, smiling and waving as the video concludes against a light background with floating text overlays.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic BGM with a steady 4/4 beat starts instantly. An adult male voice speaks with rapid tempo and excited inflection. A sharp 'pop' sound effect triggers as text bubbles appear on screen, accompanied by studio-clean room tone. (2) A 'ding' sound effect highlights the unveiling of the ice cream. There is audible laughter from the adult and a soft rustle of plastic packaging. The child's voice interjects with high-pitched curiosity. BGM remains constant at a medium volume. (3) Crunchy foley-style sound effects are layered as the characters bite into the chocolate shell. The narrator's voice becomes more descriptive, emphasizing consonants for clarity. A 'whoosh' transition sound marks the shift to a macro product shot. (4) A melodic synth stinger plays as the second product is introduced. The vocal interplay between the man and boy becomes more dynamic with frequent overlapping speech. Sharp 'mechanical clicks' underscore humorous visual edits while the BGM maintains high energy. (5) The BGM enters a repetitive loop as the speaker delivers the final rating. A concluding 'sparkle' SFX coincides with the appearance of the end-screen logo. The audio track ends with a clean fade-out of the music bed.
